Class ViewExperience

java.lang.Object
guiExperience.ViewExperience
public final class ViewExperience extends Object

Title: ViewExperience

Description: Contributor page for appending a real attempt and reading its history. Separate What/How/Elapsed/Member effort fields come from the Contributor experience story. A fresh page per visit prevents stale input from crossing accounts or lessons.
